# React Instructions

Use `.github/skills/web-frontend-development/SKILL.md`.

This file routes React context only. Load `references/react.md` only when the owning package definitively declares `react` as a dependency or peer dependency. JSX, TSX, Vite config, filenames, and directory names do not activate React by themselves.
